title: AI and Formula 1: Redefining Speed and Strategy with Intelligent Technology
description: A guide to AI in Formula 1 — real-time strategy optimisation, predictive analytics, and how intelligent technology is transforming racing.
short_description: A plain-English guide to AI in Formula 1, focused on practical use, trade-offs, and sharper questions.
